summary: Completed testing of La Bague Impériale club management app - Statistics features for moyennes (averages) display and manual data entry for historical seasons
seed_data_creation: Test manual stats saved for saisons 2, 3, and 4 during API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All statistics APIs working correctly. Stats Saisons view shows moyennes (averages) instead of percentages. Seasons 1-12 have editable input fields for manual data entry. Season 13+ is read-only with automatic calculation.

api_saisons_resume.details: Returns moy_aperos, moy_repas, moy_anniversaires, moy_global correctly

api_manual_stats.details: Saves manual presence data for historical seasons 1-12

dashboard_moyennes_display.details: Shows '11.6 présents/évén.' for global average and '16.1 présents/évén.' for current season alongside percentages

stats_saisons_view.details: Displays moyennes (averages) instead of percentages in 'Prés. / Moy.' columns. Shows Moy. Globale column

editable_historical_seasons.details: Seasons 1-12 have input fields for manual data entry (Nb Membres, Présences Apéros/Repas/Anniversaires)

readonly_current_seasons.details: Season 13+ is read-only with automatic calculation (no input fields)

save_button_functionality.details: Save button per row works - showed 'Saison 2 sauvegardée !' toast notification
